name: General Education Option

sections.title: Program Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: A 2.00 graduation grade point average (GPA) and upper division GPA is required.

sections.note:
With the exception of EDUC 401, 402, 403, 405 and 406, courses completed in any faculty may be used to satisfy degree requirements, but course admission is subject to the prerequisites of various departments.
Additional requirements are satisfied through completion of the general education option, as specified below.
Note: EDUC 100W, EDUC 252 and EDUC 352W must be completed before starting the Professional Development Program (PDP).

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: In addition to the courses specified above, students who choose this option will complete nine lower division and 15 upper division units in EDUC courses.

sections.title: Elective Courses
sections.note: In addition to the courses listed above, students should consult an academic advisor to plan the remaining required elective courses.
